stock.description: Lung Kee Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and markets mould bases and related products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company also engages in the property investment and corporate management activities. The company was formerly known as Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Limited and changed its name to Lung Kee Group Holdings Limited in June 2024. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong. Lung Kee Group Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Pan Island Investments Limited.
